description: People and registration: Members list rebuilt (filters, search, no quick edit, BA-only export), new member.html student record with role-limited edits, Registrations page (checklists, Activate/Request info/Flag, no refund wording, MC extensions with Return lesson / Extend expiry, BA Exceptions), new register.html assisted registration, new followups.html. Covers R50-R70 (plan.md section 1C). Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (equipment rows, Take payment, exceptions list).
steps: Read FEAT-001/002 findings and plan.md R50-R70. Read admin.js (openApp, approveApp, renderApps, MC functions, renderMembers, openMember), landingpage/join.html + join.js for form field patterns, student_portal/student.js lines ~214-290 (MC request shape), core.js signaturePad.

Create admin_portal/admin-members.js. Move/rewrite from admin.js: renderMembers (columns Member, Belt, Centre, Package, Membership, Last seen), filters All/Active/Lapsed/Expiring soon/Outstanding balance/New (90 days)/Guests, search by name, no., phone, email, guardian; row click goes to member.html?no=; remove the quick-edit drawer (openMember) and its admin.js binding; Export CSV gets data-ba. Remove migrated functions from admin.js without breaking other pages that still use admin.js (sessions, grading).

Create admin_portal/member.html (data-page="member") + logic: header with name, member no., belt, centre, status chips, Adult/Child with guardian; buttons Book a class (links roster flow), Take payment, Log contact, Send message; tabs Overview, Bookings, Attendance, Payments (reprint receipt via makePDF), Progress, Equipment, Follow-ups, Contact; DB.memberInfo[no] filled by a deterministic default generator so every member has data; FD edits phone/email/emergency contact/guardian only; belt, membership status, principal dojo read-only for FD; belt read-only for everyone with 'Changes through grading only'; BA (data-ba) can change membership status and principal dojo with a required reason; FD sees medical note and MCs in full, NS papers and experience certificates show 'Verified'/'On file' to FD and open in a modal for BA only; refund list with FD request / BA approve.

applications.html (Registrations): tabs Registrations, Extensions, Exceptions (data-ba). Registration rows with checklist chips (details, consent, paid, medical, guardian consent, returning member 2-year rule, grade carry-over) and status Ready to activate / Missing info / Needs review; actions Activate (enabled only when DB.policies auto-activation rules pass), Request missing info, Flag for review (reason, creates DB.exceptions), Reject (modal text without refund wording: no 'Reject and refund'); activation adds the member (existing approveApp behaviour), pushes DB.equipment rows (dogi, handbook, belt), and carries-over starting grade is shown disabled for FD with 'Confirmed by Business Admin'. Extensions tab: rewrite openMCReq/approveMC with tickboxes Return lesson and Extend expiry (default ticked), Unlimited plan rule (record excused, no return/extend), MC <= 14 days FD or BA can approve, otherwise 'Refer to Business Admin', compassion confirm; keep MC_REQS field names and set returnLesson/extend; update the pass via MY_PASSES for the demo student; add HTML comment DEBUG PANEL placeholder for MC outcomes. Exceptions tab lists DB.exceptions with Approve/Decline + reason. Update setCount('applications') to include pending items.

Create admin_portal/register.html (data-page="register", parent Registrations): assisted registration form with forms.css fields: personal details incl. date of birth, contact, guardian for minors, find-existing External member and add ASK membership, medical declaration, consent PDPA/terms with signaturePad, dogi size, package, NS proof (mock upload, FD sees only a verified label), discount shown from discountFor(), payment via the Take payment Stripe mock; on submit pushes an APPS-style record (or activates per rules) and equipment request. Do not change landingpage/join.*.

Create admin_portal/followups.html + logic in admin-desk.js or admin-members.js: tabs Newcomers not returned, Declining attendance (isDeclining / seen >= 14), Renewals coming up (30 days), Assigned to me; rows with reason, last seen, phone, attempts, due date; Log contact drawer (method, outcome incl. 'not returning' reason, notes, next date) writing DB.followups; reminder note per R68; BA-only (data-ba) create list, assign, reassign, review outcomes. BA Overview's 'Low attendance flags' target is set in FEAT-004 but add the followups page key now.

Create .admin-fix-tmp/verify/verify-feat3.mjs asserting R50-R70 per plan.md 5.3, including the MC chain with the student portal bell and the Unlimited / over-14-day branches; screenshots at 1280 and 390 of members, member (plus drawer/modal), applications (each tab), register, followups. Run verify-feat1..3 and regress; fix failures. Record findings: DB shapes for memberInfo/followups/exceptions, MC field additions.
acceptance_criteria: Members shows the required filters/columns/search fields; each row opens member.html; Export CSV and quick-edit drawer are gone for Admin, Export exists only for Business Admin.

member.html: Admin cannot edit belt, membership status or dojo; BA can change status and dojo only after entering a reason; belt is never editable; Admin sees medical note and MCs but NS shows only 'Verified'.

Approving an MC with both boxes ticked extends the demo student's pass expiry and returns one lesson; unticking Extend expiry leaves expiry unchanged; Unlimited marks excused with no changes; MC over 14 days shows 'Refer to Business Admin' for Admin.
No UI text says 'Reject and refund'; Flag for review creates a BA exception that appears under Exceptions only for Business Admin.
register.html requires date of birth and signature, shows the 17-25 discount from DOB, and activating a registration creates equipment requests.
followups.html has the four tabs, logging contact increments attempts, and BA-only controls are absent from the DOM for Admin.
No horizontal overflow at 390px; no console errors; student and instructor portals still load.
findings: VERIFIED: verify-feat3 152/152, verify-feat2 104/104, verify-feat1 125/125, regress 17/17. Nothing staged or committed. FILES: new admin-members.js (members, member, applications, register, followups pages), member.html, register.html, followups.html; rewritten members.html and applications.html (both now load admin-desk.js then admin-members.js, no longer admin.js); admin.js lost renderApps/renderMCReqs/openMCReq/approveMC/openApp/approveApp/renderMembers/openMember (promote() no longer calls renderMembers); portal.js additive: Registrations badge adds pending DB.exceptions for BA, student bell shows 'Absence excused' when r.excused; index.html Low attendance flags now links to followups (R70 done); portal.css additive block (.chips, .rec-chips, .rec-sec, .mc-ticks, .tbl .who a). GLOBALS in admin-members.js (do not redeclare): mbDate, mbJoinedDate, mbSeen, mbSeenText, mbDigits, mbOwed, mbInfo/mbInfoDefault/mbSetInfo, mbPhone, mbPkg/mbPkgText/mbExpiring/mbRereg, mbNewNo, memUI, fuRecord, logContactDrawer(m, kind, after), MB, FU_KINDS, regRules/regReviews/regBlock, activateApp(a, grade), appCount, MC_FD_LIMIT, mcUnlimited, mcWithin, mcApprove, EXC_KINDS, RG, rg* helpers, fuCandidates/fuRows. DB SHAPES: DB.memberInfo[no] = {phone,email,emergency{name,rel,phone},guardian,medical,mcs[{from,to,status,file}],ns 'Verified'|null,cert 'On file'|null,rated,log[{at,by,text,reason}]} filled with deterministic defaults when a record is opened; DB.followups rows unchanged shape ({id,no,name,kind declining|renewal|newcomer,owner,due,attempts[{at,method,outcome,note,by}]}), created on first Log contact; DB.exceptions gains optional mcId, reason, decidedBy, decidedAt; APPS rows gain optional flagged (reason string), infoRequested {at,text}, dob, dogiSize, assisted, nsProof; MEMBERS gain askSince when External joins ASK; MC_REQS keep all old fields and gain returnLesson, extend, excused, referred, decidedBy, decidedAt. DECISIONS: Activate is enabled only when every switched-on DB.policies.autoActivation rule passes AND, for the front desk, the registration has no review item (returning member, Aikido carry-over, flagged); BA can activate review items and confirm the carried-over grade. Registration activation pushes three DB.equipment rows (Dogi with size, Handbook, Belt; paid true, Requested). MC: FD approves only when an MC file is attached and days <= 14; otherwise 'Refer to Business Admin' (creates extension exception with mcId, MC stays pending, BA approves it on Extensions and the linked exception is auto-approved). Unlimited plan (passName matches /unlimited/i or no pass and DB.unlimited) records excused with no lesson or expiry change. Compassion: Return lesson is disabled, a confirm tickbox is required. Both tickboxes off is blocked (use Not approved). Members list guests filter shows DB.guests rows (no record link). Assisted registration: activates immediately and writes one ledger row per fee item (Stripe, discounted amounts) unless a grade is carried over, in which case an APPS row waits for the BA. External match keeps its EXT number and gets source 'ASK'. NS upload is mock (FD sees only a 'Sent for verification' label). Belt is never an editable control anywhere. LIMITS: Book a class on the record links to sessions.html (no per-student booking prefill); Take payment on the record does not refresh an open Payments tab until it is re-clicked; Exceptions tab does not list DB.refunds (those are decided in Payments). Verify helper: addMC(page, extra) injects a pending MC for the demo student from inside the page then calls renderAll(). Screens: fd-members/member/applications-registrations/extensions/register-done/followups at 1280, fd-*-390 for members, member, applications (+drawer), register, followups, ba-member, ba-applications-exceptions, ba-followups.
